title: Export site as ZIP, now the Download step of the Publish tab: the privacy line is one strip with the approved words, what the ZIP holds is shown as tags (no collapsible Export details row), and the backup download dialog focuses itself
steps: S1: Open the ZIP step of the Publish tab (choose 'Download a ZIP', or 'Export site as ZIP' in the '…' menu) on a site with no package yet.
S2: On the same step read the privacy strip and the list of what the ZIP holds.
S3: Open the Backup download dialog and read the focused element, then press Tab.
expect: S1: the step is at stage 'confirm' ([data-export-stage="confirm"]) and its footer offers Prepare ZIP ([data-export-start]).

S2: one [data-export-privacy] strip reads 'Contains personal data and site secrets. Keep it private.'; [data-export-details] lists four tags (fresh backup, files over 50 MB included, up to 1 GiB, README); there is no collapsible details row.
S3: the dialog itself holds focus on open; Tab reaches a button.

selectors.tool: node --test DOM test of the ZIP step (jsdom), and the browser test of the backup download dialog

evidence: On dev the dialog was 448px (sm:max-w-md) and the word 'private.' wrapped alone onto a second line; the test measured 2 line boxes before the change; the dialog focused the Export details trigger on open, and with no preflight its bare `border` painted in currentColor (oklch(0.145 0 0) in light, near-white on the dark dsh page)
fence: The real ZIP step and its hook in jsdom with the export doors stubbed (English words of the plugin's own table); the one-line measurement of the old 512px dialog has no counterpart since the dialog became a step of the Publish tab (23/10/2026)

tests: ZIP: the confirm step lists what the package holds as tags and keeps the privacy line, with no collapsible box
ZIP: a server that cannot say (an older server, an error) opens on Prepare ZIP
opening the backup download dialog focuses the dialog, not its first button
